# self-stuff

Personal learning, coursework and experiments in one repo.

The root `pyproject.toml` is a shared uv environment for quick scripts (`uv run experiments/...`). Imported folders keep their own dependency files.

<!-- generated by scripts/import-repos.sh; edits above the index are kept -->

Each folder is a snapshot of an older GitHub repo; the original keeps the full history.
